name: native-measured-unit-identity
goal: Preserve source identities for every measured or removed unit after verification releases indexes

evidence: Linux CI run 40421510002 failed attaching a verification record because benchmarked service.title was outside impact and its source files had been pruned before record assembly.

test/verify-measures.e2e.test.ts checks metrics for impacted units but not source identities for a benchmarked non-impacted unit or a removed base unit; extend that standard fixture to assert both and attach the measured record.
The Desktop recorded-artifact fixture failed at 9cab783e5b73e130770a4e41cdd83d107fd5da69 because benchmarked service.title lost its committed source hash before attachment.
e2851bc0f1946cff58cc105f1eb9966d575fa6bf retains hash-only unit source facts for record assembly while releasing full unneeded index entries.
The unchanged Desktop recorded-artifact suite passed 4 of 4 at e2851bc0f1946cff58cc105f1eb9966d575fa6bf with the committed source identity intact.
